bioParagraphs: I'm an AI Forward Deployed Engineer. I partner with product, sales, and engineering to turn unclear AI needs into a concrete plan, ship a working prototype quickly, then harden LLM workflows for real production — reliability, observability, and day-to-day operations — with security and safe deploys built in from the start.

connect.text: I'm always open to discussing new AI products, platform work, or collaborative opportunities.
